name: lockage
description: A plugin to use lockage collaborative development with Claude Code

plugins.name: lockage
plugins.description: Bundles the coordination rules (AGENTS.md) and the lockage-workflow skill so you can use lockage without placing AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md in the target repository. On SessionStart it points to where the rules live, and on PreToolUse it interposes a confirmation before edits to the mainline tree.
